WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb) AS has_detail,
    (jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0) AS has_pricebooks,
    p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' AS charging_accessibility,
    p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,site_status}' AS site_status,
    p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,project_status}' AS project_status,
    p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,access_type}' AS access_type
  FROM pois p
  WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.category = 'supercharger'
    AND (${country:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.country::text IN (${country:sqlstring}))
    AND (${region_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.region ILIKE '%' || ${region_search:sqlstring} || '%')
    AND (${accessibility:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' IN (${accessibility:sqlstring}))
), scoped AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM filtered
  WHERE ${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'all'
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_detail' AND has_detail)
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_detail' AND NOT has_detail)
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_pricebooks' AND has_pricebooks)
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_pricebooks' AND NOT has_pricebooks)
)
SELECT count(*) AS superchargers FROM scoped;

targets.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    (p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' IS NOT NULL AND p.properties->'upstream'->'detail' <> 'null'::jsonb) AS has_detail,
    (jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(p.properties->'pricebooks') > 0) AS has_pricebooks,
    p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' AS charging_accessibility,
    p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,site_status}' AS site_status,
    p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,project_status}' AS project_status,
    p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,access_type}' AS access_type
  FROM pois p
  WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND p.category = 'supercharger'
    AND (${country:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.country::text IN (${country:sqlstring}))
    AND (${region_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.region ILIKE '%' || ${region_search:sqlstring} || '%')
    AND (${accessibility:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.properties#>>'{upstream,index,supercharger_function,charging_accessibility}' IN (${accessibility:sqlstring}))
), scoped AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM filtered
  WHERE ${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'all'
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_detail' AND has_detail)
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_detail' AND NOT has_detail)
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'with_pricebooks' AND has_pricebooks)
     OR (${detail_state:sqlstring} = 'missing_pricebooks' AND NOT has_pricebooks)
), pricebook_rows AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    coalesce(nullif(p.country::text, ''), '(unknown)') AS country,
    coalesce(nullif(p.region, ''), '(unknown)') AS region,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'currencyCode', '') AS currency,
    NULLIF(pricebook->>'rateBase', '')::numeric AS rate_base,
    ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lng,
    ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat
  FROM scoped p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.properties->'pricebooks') = 'array' THEN p.properties->'pricebooks' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) AS e(pricebook)
  WHERE pricebook->>'feeType' = 'CHARGING'
    AND pricebook->>'uom' = 'kwh'
    AND pricebook->>'vehicleMakeType' = 'TSLA'
    AND NULLIF(pricebook->>'currencyCode', '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(pricebook->>'rateBase', '') IS NOT NULL
), site_prices AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    country,
    region,
    currency,
    avg(rate_base) AS site_avg_price_per_kwh,
    min(rate_base) AS site_min_price_per_kwh,
    max(rate_base) AS site_max_price_per_kwh,
    max(lng) AS lng,
    max(lat) AS lat
  FROM pricebook_rows
  GROUP BY id, country, region, currency
)
SELECT
  country,
  region,
  currency,
  round(avg(site_avg_price_per_kwh), 3) AS avg_price_per_kwh,
  count(*) AS priced_superchargers,
  round(min(site_min_price_per_kwh), 3) AS min_price_per_kwh,
  round(max(site_max_price_per_kwh), 3) AS max_price_per_kwh,
  avg(lng) AS lng,
  avg(lat) AS lat
FROM site_prices
GROUP BY country, region, currency
ORDER BY avg_price_per_kwh DESC, priced_superchargers DESC, country ASC, region ASC;
